neighbours.label: the word synthetic, synthes- and its Chinese and Japanese equivalent 合成, as opposed to natural materials and other adjectives in the same sentences

这种布料是用合成纤维做的。

このシャツは合成繊維でできている。

这种布料是用天然棉花做的。
